provider.description: Transport: folder (file handoff) or database (customer table). Editable at runtime in Config → MES.

enabled.description: Block runs unless the previous stage passed.

on_missing.description: Behaviour when no upstream record exists.

on_error.description: Behaviour when the MES source cannot be read (database down, timeout). Default block.

enabled.description: Write this stage's result downstream on run-finish.

database.description: Database transport defaults; normally set in Config → MES and stored as the mes_db_config record (passwords never in app.json).

connection.description: provider mysql|sqlserver|sqlite, host, port, user, password, odbc_driver, path

table.description: Table or view; 'schema.table' for a non-default schema.

allow_value.description: Status value that allows the run; anything else blocks.

upstream_dir.description: Previous stage's output dir (has PASS/ FAIL/). Empty = first stage.

downstream_dir.description: This stage's output dir (PASS/ FAIL/ written here).
